newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.181 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.181 mln gallons.

text.p: Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended Aug 9 was 5,181,526 gallons compared with 4,691,041 gallons last week.
Imports were 2,063,228 gallons compared with 368,092 gallons the previous week. There were 86,628 domestic receipts this week compared with 66,704 the previous week.
Retail movement was 732,657 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,850,132 gallons.
The net cumulative pack for the season is 242,268,243 gallons.
